question: How much of Experiment 06's wrong label reuse disappears when confusable labels merge into a smaller catalogue built from development evidence only?
decision: Which catalogue (41 labels or a merged version) and which scoring ruler Experiments 12 and 13 use.
exploratory: Post-hoc: Experiment 06 answers were already inspected. Results can choose inputs for later experiments; they cannot approve a production change.

H1.statement: At L20, at least ceil(N / 2) of the N label-versus-label wrong picks in cell C1 are correct in cell C3.

hypotheses.H0: Fewer than ceil(N / 2) become correct at L20.
hypotheses.known_ceiling: 28 of 42 wrong picks in the Experiment 10 re-score fall on reference none_fit cases; merging cannot change them; best possible W/E is 28/71 = 0.394.

decision_rule.pass: H1 and G5 hold: the L20 merge map becomes the draft catalogue for Experiments 12 and 13; definitions are rewritten in a separate step.
decision_rule.fail: H1 fails: keep 41 labels for Experiment 12 and report the label pairs that stayed confused.
decision_rule.unclear: H1 holds but G5 fails: INCONCLUSIVE; do not retune targets; the user decides the catalogue for Experiment 12.

stats.test: count comparison at L20; no significance test
stats.interval: exact one-sided 95% binomial upper bound on W/E per cell, standard-library summation

ruler.correct_pick: the chosen label lies in the case's acceptable-label set; none_fit answers and review routing never count as reuse
ruler.metric: W/E among accepted reuse picks with exact one-sided 95% upper bound U

tier2_production.data: a fresh labelled set never used for design or tuning

ruler.two_percent: long-run aim only; no longer a gate (needs 149 accepts with W == 0)

gates.G1_integrity: every pinned hash verifies before and after; build outputs are hashed into the manifest before scoring
gates.G2_completeness: all 140 cases carry one scored outcome in every cell
gates.G3_reproduction: cell C0 gives E 71, C 29, W 42, matching the Experiment 10 summary
gates.G4_build_blindness: the build phase reads development records and the catalogue only; an injected test record is refused
gates.G5_guardrail: at L20, no merged label holds more than 30% of its section's reference-positive test cases

acceptable_sets.widen_when: drafter label and judge label are both existing catalogue labels and differ; add both
acceptable_sets.known_effect: 9 of 10 remaining disputes set a label against none_fit or uncertain; at most 1 case widens

merge_maps.signal: Experiment 09 Clef calibration records (arm clef, phase calibration): p_yes per development case and same-section definition; 60 positive and 1170 negative pairs
merge_maps.similarity: mean p_yes over development cases of L scored against M's definition and development cases of M scored against L's definition
merge_maps.clustering: average linkage within each section; merge the most similar cluster pair one at a time; ties broken by the lexically smallest pair of sorted member-id lists

amendments.reason: The build phase also writes the acceptable-label sets, which need the Experiment 10 adjudication files. G4 as written forbade that.
amendments.change: G4 applies to merge-map construction: it reads development records and the catalogue only, and refuses an injected test record. Acceptable-label sets read the Experiment 10 reference and dispute files. Neither part reads Experiment 06 answers; only the score phase does.
